Product Features

  • The exquisite high-gloss double-layer coffee table creates a luxurious and elegant aesthetic and comfortable living environment. It is not only a coffee table, but also a pursuit of perfection in life.
  • The white tabletop and marble bases give the living room an elegant style.
  • The height above the ground is convenient for the robot sweeper to pass, which makes cleaning easy and convenient
  • Multifunctional double-layer coffee table, the top white coffee table can be rotated 360 degrees to meet your various needs
  • The concave shelf on the lower level is simple, stylish and customized, which improves the overall score.
  • The entire coffee table is made of chipboard, and the skirting board at the bottom is marble instead of marbled.
  • The white tea table top is a visible highlight that improves the brightness of the living room and makes the tea table no longer appear dim.
  • The coffee table is designed as a whole, and the thick and practical materials enhance the overall support. At the same time, it ensures that the square coffee table is durable, does not deform, and has a long service life.
  • The product size is 70*70*36cm, and the coffee table has a load capacity of 30kg.
  • The chipboard is rust-proof, oxidation-resistant, wear-resistant and scratch-resistant. The large side table on the floor offers space for everyday things.
